findings: Owner request 2026-11-10: practice long questions for Unit 6 in the same format as the other books' chapter practice, long questions in the Mathematics Board Section-II shape (5-mark parts) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the unit; not printed in the book. 29 questions numbered 1-29; by section: 6.1.2 1, 6.1.3 1, 6.1.4 1, 6.1.5 4, 6.2.1 1, 6.2.4 1, 6.2.5 2, 6.2.6 1, 6.2.7 1, 6.3 1, 6.3.1 1, 6.3.3 2, 6.3.4 1, 6.4 1, 6.4.2 2, 6.4.3 1, 6.5 1, 6.5.2 2, 6.5.3 1, 6.6 3.

Five-mark questions: the unit's derivations (general form of a circle, diameter form, tangent to the general circle, position of a point, condition of tangency and point of contact for circle, parabola and ellipse, length of the tangent, standard equations of the parabola, ellipse and hyperbola) and its main problem types (circles from three conditions, tangents from a point, analysing shifted parabolas, ellipses and hyperbolas, tangents through a point to a hyperbola, real-life problems) with new data. Book corrections followed (ellipse point of contact (-a^2 m/c, b^2/c) for either sign, hyperbola tangents only for a^2 m^2 > b^2, Example 29 root choice). Every step was checked by computation (sympy, check6.py).
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
